summary: @actualham I agree and our onboarding getting easier everyday. Anyone can start with @mocrodotblog today, use a CMS like WordPress, or for those inclined build a CMS. But probably very few in #IndieWeb community who didn't start on some commercial silo first
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@actualham I agree and our onboarding getting easier everyday. Anyone can start with @mocrodotblog today, use a CMS like WordPress, or for those inclined build a CMS.

But probably very few in #IndieWeb community who didn't start on some commercial silo first
